messages:
maya-support: Customer reported tool call failures after model rollout to v2.1 canary (20%). They see schema validation errors and tool arg malformation. Example payload they sent:

maya-support: ```json
{ "model": "redwood-embed-v2.1", "input": "Find address of 1600 Amphitheatre Pkwy", "tools": [{"name":"fetch_address","schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"query":{"type":"string"}}}}]
}
```

maya-support: Customer logs show downstream service rejecting function call: "schema validation failed: required property 'location' missing" and our gateway returned 400.

jon-eng: Can you paste the raw request and the inference trace (model->tool_choice) from the gateway logs? Also which region and canary %?

maya-support: Raw gateway request attached above. Canary: us-west2, 20% traffic. Inference trace snippet:

maya-support: ```log
[2026-03-16T11:02:03Z] model=redwood-serve-v2.1 trace_id=abc123 -> tool_choice: geocode
[2026-03-16T11:02:03Z] model=redwood-serve-v2.1 -> emit_function_call: name=geocode args={"address":"1600 Amphitheatre Pkwy"}
[2026-03-16T11:02:03Z] gateway -> forward to service fetch-address-service payload={"location":null}
```

irene-ml: Hmm model selecting geocode vs fetch_address suggests the model's tool selection embedding/classifier was updated in v2.1. Could be a tokenization or prompt change causing preference for 'geocode' and producing different arg schema. Any examples where fetch_address was selected but args malformed?

maya-support: Yes — when fetch_address is selected we still see args shape wrong: args come as positional string "1600 Amphitheatre Pkwy" rather than JSON with {"location":"..."}.

sam-runtime: Can we repro locally? steps to repro + minimal curl to the hosted API please.

maya-support: Repro curl:

maya-support: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.inference/v1/generate 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' 
  -d '{"model":"redwood-serve-v2.1","input":"Get full address for googleplex","tools": [{"name":"fetch_address","schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"location":{"type":"string"}},"required": ["location"]}}] }'
```

carla-support: Customer also reported latency spike for canary users ~150ms additional P95, might be retry loops from failed function calls.

ben-eng: I pulled the router logs. When model=redwood-serve-v2.1 we see tool_choice heuristics return alias 'geocode' for some intents. The mapping layer expects canonical tool ids; our router maps aliases to canonical, but the model sometimes emits shorthand arguments (positional string). Two mitigation paths: 1) short-term: add an arg-normalization filter in gateway to coerce positional string into {"location":str} when tool=fetch_address; 2) long-term: revert model rollout and run evals on toolcall schema fidelity.

incidents-bot: Incident INC-2026-412 created for canary toolcall regressions. Priority: P2. https://incidents.internal/INC-2026-412

jon-eng: Agree with rollback. Set canary to 0% for v2.1 and route back to v2.0. Also add temporary arg-normalizer. Can someone own customer comms?

maya-support: I'll message the customer and offer a workaround + ETA. For transparency we'll say we've paused v2.1 canary and investigating.

sam-runtime: Rolling back canary now. Running: `cli rollout set --model redwood-serve-v2.1 --canary 0 --region us-west2`

sam-runtime: Rollback done. Monitoring for errors.

ben-eng: I opened GH issue redwood/serving#789: "v2.1 toolcall arg shapes & aliasing" with trace samples and suggested tests.

irene-ml: We'll run a targeted eval suite that checks tool name/token outputs and arg schema for ~300 prompt variants. Also will inspect prompt template changes between 2.0 and 2.1.

maya-support: Customer updated: acknowledged, no immediate outage for their customers, asked for ETA on fix. I'll escalate if they push for SLA credits.

carla-support: Noted billing team might see a credit request if retries caused cost spike. Keeping finance in loop.

jon-eng: Thanks team. Follow-ups: (1) sam to confirm rollback metrics (2) ben to push arg-normalizer PR (3) irene to run evals and report false-positive rate by EOD tomorrow.

maya-support: Closing thread for now, will re-open if customer reports further issues. :white_check_mark:
